import ast,hashlib,json,runpy,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('.local/e2e');r=runpy.run_path('e2e/execution-suite.py');checkpoint=json.loads((b/'invocation-route-cycles-checkpoint.json').read_text());assert checkpoint['completed']
path=Path(checkpoint['archive_report_path']);report=json.loads(path.read_text());assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==checkpoint['after']['report']['sha256']
assert report['completed'] and len(report['function_ids'])==1 and len(report['guards'])==4
mapping={report['namespace_id']:report['function_ids']}
physical=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(r['remote'](['python3','-B','/srv/p2enjoy-serverless/e2e/storage-console-inspect.py',json.dumps(mapping)],'root'),text=True,timeout=180));assert physical['completed']
guard=runpy.run_path('e2e/invocation-route-guard.py');local=[]
for item in report['guards']:
 folder=Path(item['folder']);identity=json.loads((folder/'identity.json').read_text());restored=json.loads((folder/'restored.json').read_text())
 assert identity==item['identity'] and restored==item['restoration'] and restored['completed'] and not guard['alive'](identity['guard'])
 local.append({'folder':str(folder),'identity_sha256':hashlib.sha256((folder/'identity.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'restoration_sha256':hashlib.sha256((folder/'restored.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'guard_absent':True})
tree=ast.parse(Path('.local/collect-invocation-domain-physical.py').read_text());node=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='program' for t in n.targets));program=ast.literal_eval(node.value)
program+='\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0,"/srv/p2enjoy-serverless/e2e")\nfrom control_database import read_control\n'
program+='with read_control(Path("/srv/p2enjoy-serverless/state/control.sqlite3")) as db:\n'
program+=' assert db.execute("SELECT description FROM namespaces WHERE id=?",('+repr(report['namespace_id'])+',)).fetchone()[0]=='+repr(report['ownership_nonce'])+'\n'
program+=' assert db.execute("SELECT description FROM services WHERE id=?",('+repr(report['service_id'])+',)).fetchone()[0]=='+repr(report['ownership_nonce'])+'\n'
raw=subprocess.run(r['SSH']+['root@10.77.0.24','python3 -B -'],input=program,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=120).stdout
installation=json.loads(raw);before=json.loads(Path('.local/e2e/invocation-native-final-installation.json').read_text())
assert installation['services']==before['services'] and installation['official_sha256']==before['official_sha256'] and installation['agent_active']
routes=guard['inspect']();assert all(v['target_port']==18090 for v in routes.values())
assert routes[guard['CANONICAL']]['id']==report['guards'][0]['identity']['canonical_id']
assert routes[guard['ALIAS']]['id']==report['guards'][-1]['identity']['alias_ids'][-1]
d={'completed':True,'namespaces':1,'functions':1,'physical':physical,'local_guards':local,'installation':installation,'console_routes':routes,'snapshot':r['snapshot']('.local/e2e/invocation-route-cycles.json',False,include_adapter=True)}
assert d['snapshot']['source_sha256']==checkpoint['after']['source_sha256']
(b/'invocation-route-cycles-physical.json').write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'completed':True,'functions_purged':1,'namespaces':1,'guards_absent':4,'routes_restored':2,'services_unchanged':True}))

def equivalent(native,client,prefix=''):
 if isinstance(native,dict):
  assert isinstance(client,dict) and set(native)==set(client),'guard_field_mismatch'
  for key in native:equivalent(native[key],client[key],prefix+'/'+key)
 elif isinstance(native,list):
  assert isinstance(client,list) and len(native)==len(client),'guard_list_mismatch'
  for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(native,client)):equivalent(a,b,prefix+'/'+str(i))
 elif native!=client:
  assert prefix.rsplit('/',1)[-1] in ('started_at_ns','finished_at_ns') and isinstance(native,int) and isinstance(client,int),'guard_material_value_mismatch'
  assert abs(native)>2**53 and float(native)==float(client) and abs(native-client)<=math.ulp(float(native)),'guard_timestamp_not_same_javascript_number'
  numeric_differences.append({'path':prefix,'native_nanoseconds':native,'javascript_json_number':client})
archive=b/'invocation-route-cycles-qualified'/'native-guards';archive.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

 folder=Path(item['folder']);identity=json.loads((folder/'identity.json').read_text());restored=json.loads((folder/'restored.json').read_text())
 equivalent(identity,item['identity'],str(len(local))+'/identity');equivalent(restored,item['restoration'],str(len(local))+'/restoration')
 assert restored['completed'] and not guard['alive'](identity['guard'])
 for source in ['identity.json','restored.json']:shutil.copy2(folder/source,archive/(str(len(local))+'-'+source))
 local.append({'folder':str(folder),'identity_sha256':hashlib.sha256((folder/'identity.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'restoration_sha256':hashlib.sha256((folder/'restored.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'guard_absent':True})
tree=ast.parse(Path('.local/collect-invocation-domain-physical.py').read_text());node=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='program' for t in n.targets));program=ast.literal_eval(node.value)
program+='\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0,"/srv/p2enjoy-serverless/e2e")\nfrom control_database import read_control\n'
program+='with read_control(Path("/srv/p2enjoy-serverless/state/control.sqlite3")) as db:\n'
program+=' assert db.execute("SELECT description FROM namespaces WHERE id=?",('+repr(report['namespace_id'])+',)).fetchone()[0]=='+repr(report['ownership_nonce'])+'\n'
program+=' assert db.execute("SELECT description FROM services WHERE id=?",('+repr(report['service_id'])+',)).fetchone()[0]=='+repr(report['ownership_nonce'])+'\n'
raw=subprocess.run(r['SSH']+['root@10.77.0.24','python3 -B -'],input=program,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=120).stdout
installation=json.loads(raw);before=json.loads(Path('.local/e2e/invocation-native-final-installation.json').read_text())
assert installation['services']==before['services'] and installation['official_sha256']==before['official_sha256'] and installation['agent_active']
routes=guard['inspect']();assert all(v['target_port']==18090 for v in routes.values())
assert routes[guard['CANONICAL']]['id']==report['guards'][0]['identity']['canonical_id']
assert routes[guard['ALIAS']]['id']==report['guards'][-1]['identity']['alias_ids'][-1]
d={'completed':True,'namespaces':1,'functions':1,'physical':physical,'local_guards':local,'javascript_nanosecond_representation_differences':numeric_differences,'native_guard_records_archived_byte_exact':True,'installation':installation,'console_routes':routes,'snapshot':r['snapshot']('.local/e2e/invocation-route-cycles.json',False,include_adapter=True)}
assert d['snapshot']['source_sha256']==checkpoint['after']['source_sha256']
(b/'invocation-route-cycles-physical.json').write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')

final_review.scope: Read-only local review of contracts, clients, execution/physical reports, raw guard records and their hashes, source epochs, notes, timestamp comparator and remaining qualification limits. No tests, network, services, writes or Git mutations.
final_review.result: Five real groups, seven emitted URL invocations, four ended guards, one purged function/namespace and stable material installation recouped. First collector stop retained separately; eighteen timestamp representation differences only, eight byte-exact native files verified.

Second CLI/UI pages requiring six authorized domains
